The Kunpeng DNA

Design Without Boundaries

Inspired by the ancient mythological Kunpeng—a giant fish that transforms into a bird, our design language blends fluid mechanics with boundless aerodynamic freedom.

Elegant and Majestic

The Kunpeng design philosophy is defined by two opposing yet complementary forces: the fluid grace of the ocean and the sharp, aerodynamic ambition of the sky.

Aero-Sculpted Lines

Form Meets Physics

The Skyline Profile

Zen Interior Architecture

i-Land Concept

The Genesis of Voyah Form

The i-Land concept car was the pure manifestation of the Kunpeng philosophy. It introduced the world to our signature "Light Sword" interactive headlights and the floating roofline.

  • Light Wings: Symmetric daytime running lights crossing the grille.
  • Surging Waves: Profile body lines that emulate ripples displacing water.
